hotel.name: Hotel Ganesh Himal
hotel.tagline: Rest at the gateway to Everest
hotel.description: A warm mountain stay in Lukla for trekkers, families, and travellers beginning or ending their Himalayan journey.
hotel.address: Lukla, Khumbu Pasang Lhamu, Solukhumbu, Nepal

rooms.name: Normal Room
rooms.description: A welcoming twin room with warm wood finishes, soft bedding, and a curtained window. A comfortable, budget-friendly base to rest before the trail or unwind after a day in the Khumbu.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: A cosy twin room with wood-panelled detailing, patterned walls, bedside lighting, and a bright, curtained window. Thoughtful finishing touches create a relaxed setting for a restful stay in Lukla.

rooms.name: Super Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Wake up to a mountain outlook in a beautifully wood-lined twin room. Soft bedding, warm bedside lighting, and a colourful traditional rug make this an inviting place to slow down and enjoy your Himalayan stay.

amenities.title: Reliable Wi-Fi
amenities.text: Stay connected and plan the next part of your journey.

amenities.title: Delicious Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner
amenities.text: Enjoy delicious breakfast, lunch, and dinner in our welcoming dining hall. Ask our team about the daily menu.

amenities.title: Hot Showers
amenities.text: A welcome refresh after a long day on the trail.

amenities.title: Luggage Support
amenities.text: Ask our team about safe short-term luggage storage.

amenities.title: Airport Nearby
amenities.text: Conveniently located for Lukla airport arrivals and departures.

amenities.title: Nearby Helipad
amenities.text: Convenient access to a nearby helipad. Ask our team for directions and local arrival information.

amenities.title: Local Guidance
amenities.text: Practical help for weather, routes, porters, and onward plans.

amenities.title: Comfortable Twin Rooms
amenities.text: Rest in welcoming wood-lined rooms with twin beds and soft bedding before or after your journey through the Khumbu.

experiences.title: Land in Lukla
experiences.text: Arrive, settle in, and take a breath before the trail begins.

experiences.title: Walk the Khumbu
experiences.text: Set out toward Phakding and the legendary Everest region.

experiences.title: Return & Restore
experiences.text: Come back to a hot meal, warm welcome, and a comfortable bed.
